name: POSTTRAN.jcl
description:
The POSTTRAN job executes program CBTRN02C to process daily credit card transactions by validating and posting them against account and cross-reference data. It reads daily transaction records, matches them against card and account information, posts valid transactions to the transaction and transaction category balance files, and writes rejected transactions to a new generation output file.Key Functionalities:
Reads daily transaction records from the daily transaction sequential file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYTRAN.PS) as the primary input for processing
Validates each transaction by cross-referencing card numbers against the card cross-reference VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CARDXREF.VSAM.KSDS) to resolve account associations
Verifies and updates account data in the account master VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.ACCTDATA.VSAM.KSDS) for valid transactions
Posts accepted transactions to the transaction VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TRANSACT.VSAM.KSDS) as a permanent transaction record
Updates transaction category balances in the transaction category balance VSAM file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.TCATBALF.VSAM.KSDS) to reflect new transaction activity
Writes rejected/invalid transactions to a new generation data group file (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.DALYREJS(+1)) with fixed-length 430-byte records for downstream error handling or review

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Daily Transaction File (DALYTRAN) is available and contains one or more card transactions for the current business day, AND the Card Cross-Reference Master (XREFFILE), Account Master (ACCTFILE), Transaction Master (TRANFILE), and Transaction Category Balance file (TCATBALF) are all accessible, AND a new generation of the Daily Rejections file (DALYREJS) has been allocated to capture any invalid transactions
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CBTRN02C program is executed to process all transactions from the Daily Transaction File (DALYTRAN)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: For each transaction in the Daily Transaction File: the card number is validated against the Card Cross-Reference Master (XREFFILE) and the associated account is validated against the Account Master (ACCTFILE); if both validations pass, the transaction is permanently posted to the Transaction Master (TRANFILE) and the Transaction Category Balance (TCATBALF) is updated for the corresponding account and category; if either validation fails, the transaction record is written to the Daily Rejections file (DALYREJS) for business review; upon successful completion of the entire job, the new generation of the Daily Rejections file is retained and cataloged as a permanent historical archive; if the job fails before completion, the Daily Rejections file for that run is automatically discarded to prevent retention of incomplete rejection data

rules.Rule_Name: STEP15 - CBTRN02C - Daily Transaction Posting and Rejection Processing
rules.Rule_Description: This step invokes the Daily Transaction Posting program (CBTRN02C) to process all card transactions submitted for the current business day. The program validates each transaction against the Card Cross-Reference and Account Master files, posts approved transactions to the Transaction Master and updates Category Balances, and routes failed transactions to a new generation of the Daily Rejections file for business review.
